concerns.text: Task T001 claims to run the end‑to‑end pipeline on simulated data generated in T003, but T003 (the producer of the simulated dataset) is scheduled *after* T001. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; T001 must be placed after T003 (or the description adjusted to run on placeholder data).

The verification step for T001 expects `pipeline.log` to contain `STATUS: SUCCESS`, which can only be produced after the full pipeline (including analysis, visualisation, and final report) has run. Therefore T001 should not be positioned before the majority of the pipeline tasks.
